units.title: Engaging with the ancient Greek world through texts

topics.title: Accessing and responding to Classical Greek texts

subtopics.title: Accessing and responding to Classical Greek texts

outcomes.text: access and interpret Classical Greek texts to explore the ancient Greek world
respond to texts and convey information in Classical Greek or English, as appropriate
develop and apply strategies to interpret and translate Classical Greek texts to convey meaning in English
understand and begin to apply the phonological and orthographic systems of Classical Greek
develop knowledge of the vocabulary, structures and features of Classical Greek grammatical systems to understand, translate and respond to texts
compare Classical Greek vocabulary and language structures and features with English, using metalanguage

topics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

subtopics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

outcomes.text: recognise that language, texts and artefacts provide insights into culture and identity

topics.title: Accessing and responding to Classical Greek texts

subtopics.title: Accessing and responding to Classical Greek texts

outcomes.text: interpret Classical Greek texts to analyse the society and culture of the ancient Greek world
respond to texts and discuss ideas about ancient Greek society in Classical Greek or English, as appropriate
apply strategies to interpret and translate Classical Greek texts to convey meaning and demonstrate understanding of context, purpose and audience
apply the phonological and orthographic systems of Classical Greek in a range of contexts
select and use vocabulary, grammatical structures and linguistic features of Classical Greek to interpret, translate, and respond to texts
explain how Classical Greek vocabulary, structures and features extend understanding of English, using metalanguage

topics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

subtopics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

outcomes.text: reflect on and explain how language, texts and artefacts provide understanding of culture and identity
